|
|-- MCP -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService -> ChangeSessionService
|
|-- create(...)
|   |-- read saved catalog documents and available histories
|   |-- overlay captured live drafts from the selected workspace
|   `-- for each captured document
|       |-- historyService.openContext(document, canvas, existingHistory)
|       |-- historyService.forkContext(context, capturedCanvas)
|       |   `-- separate contextId; captured baseline; isolated future edits
|       `-- persist ChangeSessionDocument
|           |-- baseline / proposed
|           |-- savedRevisionId / capturedVersion
|           `-- history: CanvasHistoryRecord
|
|-- apply(sessionId, documentId, version, operations, requestId)
|   |-- serialize mutation + check retry receipt
|   |-- controller(doc)
|   |   |-- migrate legacy past/future history when needed
|   |   `-- MappingDocumentController(..., doc.history, diagrams, historyService)
|   |-- controller.applyUpdate(version, operations)
|   |-- record(doc, controller)
|   |   |-- exportHistory() -> historyService.exportContext(context)
|   |   |-- update proposed document/canvas + exact nodeOrigins
|   |   `-- canonical history replaces duplicate past/future arrays
|   |-- refreshChanges(); status = draft
|   `-- repository.write(session)
|       `-- DiagramPersistence.persist -> diagram records + session references
|
|-- update(action: undo | redo | reset)
|   `-- controller -> CanvasHistoryService.navigate / reset -> record / persist
|
|-- service ownership
|   |-- DiagramService: create / revise immutable diagram content
|   |-- CanvasHistoryService: separate context handles per document
|   `-- DiagramPersistence: restore stored records
|
`-- originals remain independent
    |-- proposal edits do not publish to original canvases
    `-- accept(): validate ready state and original revisions
        |-- CanvasCatalogStore.acceptCanvasChanges(): atomic publication
        `-- freeze proposal; retain baseline/proposed review state

apply() edits the proposal; it does not accept reviewed changes.
